resolved_findings.resolution: The shared classifier now recognizes only no-question/no-resolver-owner-input authority retries as coordinator work. Label rows retain coordinator_question separately, so a no-question retry cannot hide an unrelated generic correction pause. Sixteen paired cases cover both retry kinds, four pause states and presence/absence of an actual question; the actual shared classifier and controller are exercised. The final source retains all genuine question, unknown/security hold and current-head veto authority.
resolved_findings.title: Operational authority waits with no question are classified as owner attention
resolved_findings.trigger: A linked request catches AuthorityLookupUnavailable in Intake.run and persists authority_lookup_retry=true, status=waiting, questions=[]; or wait_for_authority persists a no-question authority_wait. No actual owner question is created.
resolved_findings.evidence: Intake.question_notice_status returns eligible for any current waiting row lacking coordinator question routes, including these known operational states. labels.requests maps eligible to attention=true and attention_required turns that into needs-user when no pause exists or the retained pause is renewed planning. Intake.resume_recommendations explicitly handles these flags as automatic retries when no questions/resolver_owner_input remain.
resolved_findings.impact: The repair deterministically recreates the false needs-user label for a retry requiring no owner response, contrary to the requested separation of owner input from internal holds.
resolved_findings.requested_change: Recognize the existing verified no-question authority retry states without suppressing genuine questions, unknown waits, security/veto holds or protected approval. Add paired regression cases for authority_lookup_retry and authority_wait, plus each with a genuine question to prove owner input wins.
